description: Returns one playlist of the calling account's notebook with its songs in summary form, in playlist order, paginated by the same opaque cursor. A song the playlist still references but that has since been deleted from the notebook is simply skipped.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's `nextCursor`. Replay it verbatim; never build one.

limit.description: Page size, default 30, hard cap 100 (25 when fields="full").

playlistId.description: Stable playlist id ("pl_..."), as returned by jj_list_playlists.

name: jj_get_playlist
title: Get one notebook playlist and its songs
